title: Tailored Trouser
subtitle: Oatmeal wide leg / single pleat / rear welt pockets
status: PROPOSED DEVELOPMENT SPECIFICATION — SAMPLE VALIDATION REQUIRED
fit: High waist with 4 cm waist ease and 8 cm seat ease at base EU 38; full wide leg.
market: Adult Womenswear / EU-labelled development range; no UK conversion implied

bom.specification: PROPOSED drapey stable twill/plain suiting, 220–280 g/m²; no stretch required
bom.composition: TBD; wool blend or viscose-rich suiting option

bom.specification: PROPOSED dense smooth pocketing, 100–130 g/m², preshrunk with shell
Light woven fusible; compatibility/peel and temperature trial required
PROPOSED closed-end nylon coil No.3, 18 cm chain; matching tape
PROPOSED flat trouser hook/bar set, sew-on, 12 mm width; nickel status TBD
Core-spun polyester Tex 24–30; Nm 80–90 sharp needle after trial
35 × 12 mm neutral ID/size plus care label with unverified content withheld
Fit folded pressed sample; no hard crease across pocket area

operations.method: Finished waistband 4 cm. Fuse outer band I01; join outer to waist 10 mm SA / 301 at 2.5 mm. Inner lower edge turn under and stitch in ditch. Wearer-left overlap extension 30 mm, H01 concealed; no visible extra button.
operations.status: PROPOSED method / source-visible feature unless noted

operations.method: Use Z01 18 cm chain with separate fly facing and doubled shield. CF SA 15 mm. Stitch tape to facing/underlap at 301 / 2.5 mm; shield separates coil from skin. Fly topstitch 30 mm from CF on overlap only; reinforce base clear of coil.
operations.status: PROPOSED method / source-visible feature unless noted

operations.method: One forward pleat per front, fold toward CF; proposed 3 cm total intake, baste at waist inside 10 mm SA. Slant side pocket 16 cm opening; attach pocketing 10 mm / 301, understitch 2 mm from seam; bartack both opening ends.
operations.status: PROPOSED method / source-visible feature unless noted

operations.method: Outseam 15 mm / 301, 2.8 mm; inseam 10 mm / 301, 2.8 mm. 504-neaten edges separately and press open. Press centre leg crease from grainline, not a stitched panel seam.
operations.status: PROPOSED method / source-visible feature unless noted

operations.method: PROPOSED double welt: opening 12 × 1 cm finished, 0.5 cm each lip. Fuse opening, 10 mm sewing allowance around welt unit; 301 / 2.2 mm. Cut corners accurately, secure triangles; pocket bag depth 16 cm, 10 mm / 301 + 504.
operations.status: PROPOSED method / source-visible feature unless noted

operations.method: PROPOSED one dart per back: 2 cm intake × 9 cm long at EU 38. Sew 301 / 2.5 mm taper without backtack at tip; tie ends. CB/rise 15 mm SA, 301 / 2.5 mm, reinforce crotch curve with second row inside SA; press open above curve.
operations.status: PROPOSED method / source-visible feature unless noted

operations.method: Finished 4 cm hem allowance. 504-neaten raw edge; turn once, secure with 103 blindhemming, pick up minimal face fibres. Avoid seam allowance ridge; press through cloth after heat trial.
operations.status: PROPOSED method / source-visible feature unless noted

operations.method: Secure hook/bar to fused extension with concealed hand overcast stitches through support; do not call hand sewing a machine lockstitch. Pocket bags anchored at waist; L01 inside left waistband clear of closure.
operations.status: PROPOSED method / source-visible feature unless noted

details: 18 cm closed-end coil; separate facing and shield; 30 mm overlap extension; hook/bar concealed.
12 × 1 cm opening; two 5 mm lips; fused opening; corner triangles secured to welts; 16 cm bag depth.
3 cm total pleat intake folded toward CF; side pocket bag caught to waist, avoiding pleat bulk.
4 cm turn with 504 edge neatening; 103 minimal face pickup; outseam allowances pressed open.
pattern: Front legs ×2 mirrored incl. 3 cm pleat intake; back legs ×2 mirrored incl. dart; outer/inner waistband each ×2 shaped halves; fly facing ×1, shield ×1 doubled; side pocket bags ×4, rear bags ×4, welt strips ×4.
Front pleat intake 3 cm + back dart intake 2 cm per side are proposed seam-line shaping. Reconcile waist seam after closing darts/pleats to waistband seam length including extension.
Leg grain through knee/hem crease. Walk inseam/outseam; retain 15 mm outseam/CB for sampling adjustment. No belt loops.
assembly: Relax and shrink-test shell/pocketing; fuse-test I01 before bulk cutting.
Cut on straight grain; mark pleat, dart, welt box and zipper stops.
Fuse welt areas; make back darts then double welts and bags.
Prepare front slant pockets; baste pleats closed within waist allowance.
Assemble fly facing, Z01 and shield; complete fly curve stitching.
Close side/inseams; close rise; edge-neaten and press.
Attach outer/inner waistband; install H01, anchor pocket bags and labels.
Set leg length, blind hem, press grainline creases and cool before POM check.
qc: Rear welts level and equal; lips total 10 mm, no open corner holes.
Zip slides freely; shield covers coil; H01 aligns without waist step.
Pleats release cleanly; pocket bags cannot hang below pleat or pull waist.
Check seat/rise in sitting trial, no horizontal drag or inseam roping.
Creases track grain; hem edges equal, no face blind-stitch showthrough.
risks: Pocket and dart geometry is proposed from exterior appearance, not a measured production pattern.
Fly handedness, extension and hook/bar require sample confirmation.
Shell/fusing/pocketing shrinkage mismatch can distort waist and welt openings.
evidence: CONFIRMED in source: separate waistband, covered front closure area, one visible pleat per front, wide legs, rear horizontal welt-like openings and pressed leg lines.
Fly zip, hook/bar, pocket bags, dart intake and internal waistband construction are PROPOSED; reference is exterior photography only.
No belt loops or rear pocket buttons visible: none specified. Shirt in source is excluded.
assumptions: PROPOSED adult womenswear tailored construction with a waistband fly opening and hook/bar extension. Handedness must be confirmed at first sample; illustration uses wearer-left overlap.
Rear opening engineered as double welt pockets. Source does not prove number of welt lips or pocket-bag depth.
Use a stable woven suiting option, not stretch-knit negative ease. No full lining is required in this proposal.
consumption: ESTIMATE: shell 1.80–2.10 m at 150 cm usable width, EU 38; paired front/back legs + waistband + fly facings + welts, straight grain, no nap. Assumes two lengthwise leg rows/nesting, 12% cutting/shrink reserve. Pocketing 0.40–0.50 m at 140 cm; fusing 0.20–0.30 m at 90 cm. Directional/nap fabric increases yield; verify marker.
care: TBD: fibre identity, component compatibility, care testing, country of origin and destination-market legal review. Do not print generic care symbols.
labels: PROPOSED: neutral development ID + EU size; 35 × 12 mm soft ID label, ends turned 5 mm and secured with 301. No third-party logo or manufacturer claim. Placement: inside left waistband and pocketing.
packaging: PROPOSED: fold only after cooling; use unprinted recyclable protective sleeve sized to the actual folded sample. Bag material, gauge and dimensions TBD after packing trial. One garment per sleeve; no invented approved bag size.
